concept.title: The standard lists describe the council, not the service
concept.shortdesc: The local-government list of service types records what a local authority does, which is not how a resident looks for help.

conbody.p: The local-government list of service types was written to describe what a local authority does. Many of its entries take the form “provision of information about X”. That is how a council sees its role.
A resident sees it differently. A yoga class is a yoga class, not “provision of information about yoga”.

example.title: A North Lincolnshire example
example.p: A specialist teaching team for children with physical disabilities carried the labels “Health and wellbeing strategy” and “Sports and physical activity”. Neither would help a parent find it.
